title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 13: guarding your mouth, hope deferred, walking with the wise, and the discipline of a loving father.

questions.text: What does a wise son do, in contrast with a scoffer?
questions.explanation: A wise son listens to his father's instruction, but a scoffer doesn't listen to rebuke.

answers.text: He listens to his father's instruction

questions.text: What happens to the one who guards his mouth, in contrast with one who opens wide his lips?
questions.explanation: He who guards his mouth guards his soul, but one who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

questions.text: What does the soul of the sluggard do, in contrast with the diligent?
questions.explanation: The soul of the sluggard desires and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

questions.text: What does this chapter say some who pretend to be rich actually have?
questions.explanation: There are some who pretend to be rich yet have nothing, and some who pretend to be poor yet have great wealth.

questions.text: What happens to the lamp of the wicked, in contrast with the light of the righteous?
questions.explanation: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

questions.text: How does the saying go: "Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled..."?
questions.explanation: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

answers.text: it is a tree of life
it is sweet to the soul
it is a crown of honor

questions.text: What happens to one who walks with wise men, in contrast with a companion of fools?
questions.explanation: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

answers.text: He will be crowned with knowledge

questions.text: To whom does a good man leave an inheritance?
questions.explanation: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children's children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

answers.text: To the poor of his city

questions.text: What does this chapter say about one who spares the rod?
questions.explanation: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

questions.text: What happens to the belly of the wicked, in contrast with the righteous one who eats to the satisfying of his soul?
questions.explanation: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.

answers.text: It is never satisfied with riches
